convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (MovingAverage_FN) and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for both indicator calculation and trade execution logic. The custom filter enumeration and XMA smoothing methods require manual recreation in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal time calculation for position open calls

other_exits: Buy closed when MA is declining (Value[1]>Value[2]) and BuyPosClose input is true
Sell closed when MA is rising (Value[1]<Value[2]) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM is negative, abs(MM) is fixed lot size (0.1 lots). If MM is positive, it represents the share of deposit per deal (fractional sizing). Handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen.

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires two conditions: (1) MA direction confirmed by Value[1] vs Value[2] comparison (trending up for buy, trending down for sell), AND (2) Value[0] vs Value[1] confirms the move is continuing. SignalBar=1 means using the previous completed bar (not bar 0). The filter_mode enumeration (N4-N60) selects which harmonic filter number to use in the MovingAverage_FN custom indicator. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates that independently control permission for each trade direction and action. The LoadHistory() call ensures sufficient bar data for IsNewBar() and SeriesInfoInteger() functions. GlobalVariableDel_ in OnDeinit cleans up persistent state from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Major challenges: (1) SmoothAlgorithms.mqh contains the entire CXMA class with 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) that must be reimplemented - the MovingAverage_FN indicator logic depends on these. (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_ - all trade execution and utility functions must be ported. (3) The MovingAverage_FN custom indicator with its filter_mode harmonic filters must be fully ported before the EA logic can work. (4) No digit adjustment is done in this EA itself - SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are passed directly to trade functions, but check whether TradeAlgorithms.mqh internally adjusts for 5-digit brokers. (5) The conditional MM sizing logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) is inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh and must be replicated. (6) SignalBar=1 means reading indicator buffer from bar index 1 (last completed bar), copying 3 values at positions [1,2,3] mapped to Value[0,1,2].
